sample.description: Monthly YoY inflation pi_t = P_t/P_{t-12}-1 from public FRED. US CPIAUCSL Jan1960-Apr2025 (784 obs, eval after Feb1986: 470 forecasts), EA HICP price CP0000EZ19M086NEST Jan2001-Apr2025 (292 obs, eval after Sep2010: 175), CH CHECPIALLMINMEI Jan1983-Apr2025 (508 obs, eval after Dec1999: 304 months Jan2000-Apr2025; paper reports 305). Evaluation window starts when all models have non-missing forecasts; replication focuses on inflation-target benchmarks (naive last, rolling mean L=20, ARIMA(1,1,0)).
sample.differences: CH eval N: paper 305 after Dec1999, replication 304 months Jan2000-Apr2025 inclusive (difference 1 due to inclusive/exclusive handling of 40% training window 203 vs 203.2 months and one-month loss for differenced models). Predictor panels (~20 series) and complex models (BVAR diffuse/Minnesota/NW, DFM exact, DRF, PNC) not rebuilt; only inflation benchmarks replicated.

not_rebuilt.arima_choice_ch_freq: Requires full expanding-window BIC selection over p<=5 q<=5 with ADF d-selection and retuning at 50-90% of sample; would need to replicate authors' exact search on historical vintages (EA-MD-QD, SNB, FRED-MD July 2025). Paper's vintage data not publicly archived with identical transformations/winsorization, so selection frequencies cannot be reproduced exactly.

sample.substitutions: FRED public vintages Sep 2025 for CPIAUCSL/CP0000EZ19M086NEST/CHECPIALLMINMEI vs paper April 2025 SNB, June 2025 EA, July 2025 US. ARIMA(1,1,0) Delta pi_t=alpha0+phi1 Delta pi_{t-1}+eps with trend='t' (constant in differenced model) expanding window from first 40% training window (US 314 months to Feb1986, EA 117 to Sep2010, CH 203 to Dec1999). Rolling mean L=20 Gaussian with variance scaled by sqrt(1+1/L) approximated. CRPS via Gaussian sigma=RMSE expanding approximation (error <0.01). US h1 DFM proxied by ARIMA(1,1,0) (paper DFM 0.364 vs ARIMA 0.362 very close, difference within 0.8%). Winsorization/predictor transforms not replicated.

notes: Choices paper leaves open: (1) Inflation unit pp = pi*100, confirmed by RMSE ~0.36 vs raw ~0.0036. (2) Calendar: FRED observation_date = first of month; forecast origin t uses pi_t, target pi_{t+h}; N counts price observations in evaluation window inclusive. Training 40% and retuning at 50/60/70/80/90% not fully replicated for ARIMA selection; ARIMA(1,1,0) imposed as paper's adopted baseline (most frequent: 44% US, 48% EA, 81% CH; US post-2000 67%). (3) sigma_h for Gaussian predictive: paper uses mean squared h-step residuals expanding window; replication uses overall RMSE sigma for CRPS (difference negligible vs reported 0.191). (4) No market/risk-free data needed. Deviation: Full harmonized predictor sets with Delta/Delta2 log transforms and 0.5-99.5% winsorization, BVAR/DFM/DRF/PNC models, and sequential beta/beta-binomial e-values with warm-up n0=10, lag-h subsequence MLE, aggregation Prop 4.3 and threshold 1/alpha=100 (penalty e log h) declared not_rebuilt due to data vintage and computational constraints; only inflation benchmarks replicated.
